name: amaya-windows-bridge
description: Windows Bridge MVP — remote tool executor for the Amaya Android AI agent.

scripts.build:helper: dotnet publish native-helper/AmayaBridgeHelper.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained false
scripts.build:helper:self-contained: dotnet publish native-helper/AmayaBridgeHelper.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run build:helper && npm run copy:helper && npm run build
